name: Ranger Psychic Ranger
body:
Some rangers are attuned to occult phenomena in the world around them.

Whether they serve as hunters of elusive psychic aberrations or explorers of longforgotten occult realms, these rangers possess a number of unique abilities that help them in their quests.

Object Reading (Su)

At 1st level, you learn how to read information from items you examine.

Examining an item in this way requires you to spend 1 minute handling the item. If the item is a magic item, you learn its properties and command word as if you had successfully examined the item using detect magic and succeeded at a Spellcraft check. This ability does not reveal whether the item is cursed unless your ranger class level is equal to or greater than the caster level of the item. If the item has any historical significance, you learn one piece of information about its past (as determined by the GM). Finally, if the item was last used no longer than 1 day ago per ranger class level, you learn one piece of information about the last creature to use the item. This information might be a glimpse of the creature’s appearance, a brief vision of what it saw while using the item, or perhaps its emotional state when it last used the item.

The GM determines what information is gained in this way. This functions like the psychometry occult skill unlock, but doesn’t require a skill check and can be used at will. If you have levels in the occultist class, they stack with your levels in ranger for the purposes of this ability.

This feature replaces track and wild empathy.

Iron Will

You gain Iron Will as a bonus feat at 3rd level. This feature replaces endurance.

Phantom Animal Companion (Ex)

At 4th level, you call upon spirits of nature known as phantom animals to assist you in your journeys. A phantom animal functions like an animal companion except as noted in the descriptions below.

You must choose your phantom animal from the list of animal companions normally available to you as a ranger, and your effective druid level and spiritualist level for your phantom animal companion statistics is equal to your ranger level –3.

The phantom animal uses the statistics of an animal companion and follows the standard animal companion progression in regard to Hit Dice, base attack bonus, saving throws, skills, feats, natural armor bonus, Strength and Dexterity bonuses, and bonus tricks— but not its special abilities. A phantom animal instead gains the special abilities of a standard phantom standard phantom listed in the table on page 77 of Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Occult Adventures.

A phantom animal is an outsider with the phantom subtype, and is considered a phantom for the purpose of all feats and abilities. It is capable of becoming harbored in your consciousness like a spiritualist’s phantom, or becoming fully manifested.

When fully manifested, your phantom animal shares your favored enemy and favored terrain bonuses. When your phantom animal is confined in your consciousness, you gain an insight bonus to Perception checks and to Survival checks made to track creatures equal to 1/2 your ranger level. This feature replaces hunter’s bond and woodland stride.

Spellcasting

At 4th level, you gain spellcasting as a standard ranger, with the exception that your spells are cast as psychic spells instead of divine spells. (See Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Occult Adventures, p. 144.) Spells that would normally require verbal or somatic components instead require thought or emotion components, respectively, and only expensive material components are ever required.

This feature alters spells.

Determination

Beginning at 9th level, if you make a Will saving throw against an attack that has a reduced effect on a successful save, you instead avoid the effect entirely. This ability can only be used if you are wearing light armor, medium armor, or no armor. If you are helpless, you do not gain the benefit of this ability.

This feature replaces evasion.

Animal Senses (Su)

At 12th level, you share your phantom animal’s senses. If your phantom animal has any of the following abilities, you gain them whenever the phantom animal is harbored in your consciousness: blindsense, darkvision, low-light vision, and scent.

This feature replaces camouflage.

See Invisibility (Sp)

At 17th level, you gain see invisibility as a constant spell-like ability whenever the phantom animal is harbored in your consciousness.

This feature replaces hide in plain sight.
